I really like the secret unlock/puzzle aspect of it, even though I ended up not having the patience to avoid spoilers.  I accidentally unlocked Tachyon, then I needed to have the others ASAP.  I thoroughly enjoyed figuring out ways to unlock the two villains without dying and I agree with Heian above that sometimes I enjoy doing weird games where I don't just try to beat the villain as quickly as possible.  Now that I know the kinds of actions that are needed to unlock the promos, I'll probably try harder to unlock them on my own next time, especially if it's a character I really enjoy playing.

For what it's worth, I unlocked Cosmitron a few minutes ago in Insula Primalis.  I was using Legacy, SS Tachyon, Haka, Visionary, and AZ.  Voss had no cards out other than the the Conqueror, but I knew that the Stalwart was his top card.  Sub-Zero Atmosphere caused the Conqueror to attack at the start of turn and I destroyed it using Isothermic Transducer on Voss' turn.  Then he played the Stalwart, which I killed on AZ's turn later in the same round.  Hope that helps.

MigrantP:

It's only been 2 days since the update, we're not going to publish anything about the conditions that quickly. I will say that the part you're missing has been mentioned in this thread 

OK, so let's work on this analytically.  What do we know and what do we need to figure out:

Unlocking Cosmic Omnitron

Need:

While fighting Voss, destroy both ships (Stalwart & Conqueror) in the same round 

+ Mystery Condition

The Mystery Condition does not seem to be any of the following:

Team composition - Cosmi's been unlocked using non-overlapping sets of heroes  - so it can't be something unique to a specific hero.  [Has anyone unlocked Cosmi without having at least one variant hero on the team?]

Fight Location - Cosmi's been unlocked in both Megalopolis and Insula Primaris - so it can't be something unique to a specific env

What else have we mentioned in this thread…

Order of ships destroyed: I unlocked after taking out Stalwart first, then Conqueror worked and Chromium got it after the other order, so that doesn't seem to be relevant (which is good as it would mess up people using Savage Mana as you can't control the order it sends things to the trash).

Who does the damage / damage type: Probably not relevant, Cosmi's been unlocked after one hero destroyed both ships and after different heroes destroyed them on subsequent turns in the same round.  I've seen a couple of reports of Savage Mana unlocks, has anyone confirmed an unlock with End of Days?

Single-Shot vs. whittling: I unlocked Cosmi after single-shotting one ship with radiant damage and plinking another that was at 1hp with a projectile. Other folks used Savage Mana to discard both at once. Powerhoud took out both ships after they'd been previously whittled down.  Seems like this isn't relevant, unless I'm missing something

Voss's board: Has anyone unlocked Cosmi without having Voss's field cleared? I don't think this is relevant as Carlos said he'd gotten both ships and "Sometimes it was just Voss and the ships, other times there were minons." but do we have a data point of someone actually unlocking while Voss had other cards in play?

Voss's state: I unlocked him with Super-T Warrior side up (as did others who had been taking out all the minions). Has anyone unlocks Cosmi with Voss in Warlord state?  Voss had 81HP and 7 cards in his trash at my unlock.

Active Hero state: My unlock was triggered by RC Wraith doing 1 point of damage to the Conqueror. Wriath had 7HP at the time.

Story possibilities: Cosmi's bio says that a "mysterious cosmic entity" rocked Tachy's lab with "cosmic rays" which "gathered the many technological advancements of the lab together" and "bound them all together with wires and connections of pure energy." We know Tachyon's not required, but could there be another clue here?  Might destroying the Quark-Drive Translocator also be relevant?  Seems unlikely, but I'm trying to search for what we might have missed

Anything else?
